map.按设定数量生成合同服务条款与报价文本样例，辅助合同初稿撰写与条款模板整理，纯前端: Generate contract service terms and quotation text samples by the set quantity, to help draft contract first versions and organize clause templates; runs in the pure front end, no data uploaded.
map.起草服务合同时批量生成条款与报价样例，作为初稿再逐条修改。: When drafting a service contract, generate clauses and quotation samples in batch as a first draft and then revise item by item.
map.给客户做报价前先生成几版不同生成数量的合同草案，供内部讨论取舍。: Before quoting a client, generate several contract drafts with different generation counts for internal discussion.
map.整理合同模板库时，用生成的样例补充常见条款措辞。: When organizing a contract template library, use the generated samples to supplement common clause wording.
map.：设定生成数量 5，页面按内置服务项（网站开发、品牌策划、法律咨询等）固定顺序循: : Set the count to 5; the page cycles through the built-in service items (website development, brand planning, legal consulting and so on) in a fixed order and generates quote entries with service content, quantity and amounts in Chinese uppercase numerals, ready to serve as a quotation skeleton.
map.：生成数量须为 1–50 的整数，超出范围会提示输入有误；需要更多条目可分次生成: : The generation count must be an integer from 1 to 50; out-of-range values trigger an input error. For more entries, generate in batches and merge.
map.生成的内容能直接当合同用吗？: Can the generated content be used directly as a contract?
map.不能。生成的是措辞样例，条款效力、金额与权责需由双方确认并经法务审核，正式合同请: No. What is generated is sample wording; the effect of the terms, the amounts and the rights and obligations must be confirmed by both parties and reviewed by legal counsel, and the formal contract is the approved version.
map.不会。生成与合同条款组合全部在浏览器本地完成，服务端不接收任何输入。: No. Generation and contract-clause assembly happen entirely in the browser; the server receives no input.
map.当前按输入金额与固定顺序生成合同草案，服务项按内置列表循环使用；暂不支持锁定指定: Drafts are generated from the entered amounts in a fixed order, with service items cycling through the built-in list. Specific clauses cannot be locked yet; generate first, then adjust manually as needed.
map.→ 打开合同（服务/价格/条款）生成工具: → Open the Contract (Service / Price / Clause) Generate (free · browser-only · no data uploads)
map.本工具在浏览器本地运行，输入内容不会上传服务器；结果为模型估算，工程决策请结合实: The tool runs locally in the browser and does not upload inputs. Results are model estimates; verify engineering decisions against measured data.
